title: Poodle Dog Tags for the Smartest Diva | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny poodle dog tags, laser engraved in Lehi, Utah. Witty sayings for the smartest diva in the house, with name and number on the back. From $12.
blurb: Engraved tags for the breed that's smarter than you and knows it. These say what your poodle is already thinking about you.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Built for humidity, pool days and the groomer
tough.html:
Humid air is wet enough to ruin a blowout, and a poodle gets a blowout most weeks. Add pool splashes, salt air and a bath at every groomer visit, and a printed tag doesn't stand a chance.

We cut the words into the metal with a laser. There's no ink on top to fade, peel or wash off.

The curls may frizz. The tag won't.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Our bulldogs have never been called the smartest in the room. The poodle lines come from friends whose dogs remind them daily.

sayings.h2: 8 poodle sayings for a dog who's judging the jokes
sayings.lead: Bred to fetch ducks from cold water, somehow ended up with pom-poms and a standing appointment. Name and number go on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

items.q: Will baths, pools and humidity ruin an engraved tag?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on the surface, so there's no ink to wash off or fade.

items.q: Can I put my poodle's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for poodles?
items.a: Eight on this page, covering the brains, the haircuts, the "hypoallergenic" label and the French-but-actually-German thing. Or write your own in the builder.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
